def solution():
    # Define variables
    eur_notional = 5_000_000
    contracted_gbp_per_eur = 0.7400
    current_spot_bid = 0.7342
    three_month_forward_bid_points = 14.0 / 10_000
    gbp_90_day_libor = 0.0058
    days = 90
    basis = 360

    # Calculate the current three-month GBP/EUR forward bid rate
    current_forward_bid = current_spot_bid + three_month_forward_bid_points

    # Calculate and discount the mark-to-market gain in GBP
    undiscounted_gain = eur_notional * (
        contracted_gbp_per_eur - current_forward_bid
    )
    discount_factor = 1 + gbp_90_day_libor * days / basis
    mark_to_market_gain = undiscounted_gain / discount_factor

    # Return the answer rounded to three decimal places
    return round(mark_to_market_gain, 3)
